title: Refund Delay Index India: Days to Refund by Company
h1: Refund Delay Index: Company Refund Times After a Legal Notice
metaTitle: Refund Delay Index India: Days to Refund by Company
metaDescription: Quarterly benchmark data from LegalRecovery cases: statutory refund timelines, sector turnaround times, and pre-litigation legal notice impact.

sectors.name: E-Commerce & Quick Commerce
sectors.primaryCause: Return pickup verification lag & app wallet forced credit
sectors.statutoryLimit: 48 hours for acknowledgment; 14 days max refund

sectors.name: Airlines, Railways & OTAs
sectors.primaryCause: Arbitrary TDR rejection & credit shell retention

sectors.name: EdTech & Online Coaching
sectors.primaryCause: Free-look cancellation refusal & ongoing NBFC EMI debits
sectors.statutoryLimit: Pro-rata / full refund within 15 days of exit request

sectors.name: Fintech, Wallets & Digital Debits
sectors.primaryCause: Failed UPI transaction reversal lag & arbitrary KYC lock

sectors.name: Consumer Electronics & Appliances
sectors.statutoryLimit: 14 days replacement or full refund under Section 2(11)

methodology.sampleFrame: Consumer dispute onboarding records initiated after LegalRecovery platform launch on May 25, 2026 across Indian States and UTs. Production dataset currently undergoing verification.
inclusionCriteria: Consumer claims involving monetary refund requests where payment had been successfully debited from consumer's bank, card, or UPI.
The consumer had raised at least one official customer support ticket or escalation with the merchant/service provider.
The statutory or contractual Turn Around Time (TAT) had expired without inward settlement.
Complete documentary proof (invoices, transaction IDs, email tickets, refusal notices) was verified by an advocate.
exclusionCriteria: Suspected consumer fraud or fraudulent chargeback claims.
Peer-to-peer informal loans and unrecorded cash transfers.
Disputes where the merchant settled within standard contractual windows prior to advocate notice issuance.
Claims seeking solely non-monetary relief (apologies, policy changes).

definitions.preNoticeDelay: Total calendar days elapsed between the date of the consumer's first recorded refund grievance and the date of advocate notice dispatch.
definitions.postNoticeResolution: Calendar days elapsed between verified delivery of advocate legal notice (via Speed Post tracking or digital read receipt) and complete inward credit to consumer's bank account.
definitions.noticeResolutionRate: Percentage of claims settled in full or mutually compromised without proceeding to an adversarial trial before a Consumer Commission.

methodology.dataIntegrity: Strict empirical protocol: LegalRecovery commenced operations on May 25, 2026. In accordance with rigorous research standards, no estimated, projected, or pre-launch figures are published. Company-level benchmarks require statistically significant case volumes post-launch before individual publication.
